evd_title: Randomization sequence generation reported in only 9.7 percent and allocation concealment in 15.25 percent of RCTs
finding: Randomization sequence generation reported in only 9.7 percent and allocation concealment in 15.25 percent of RCTs
P: 21,041 open-access human RCT full texts from PubMed (of 53,137), medicine; high-confidence subset
I: GPT-4o-mini (Azure), zero-shot, one prompt per CONSORT criterion over full text (PDF->XML); 21 of 25 items; high-confidence only
O: % RCTs reporting: randomization sequence generation 9.7%, allocation concealment 15.25%, protocol access 2.22%
